independentVariable: Surface a stable sanitized degradation warning when an explicitly injected query-conditioned evidence verifier returns verifier errors. Admission/ranking semantics remain unchanged.
claimBoundary: This worker proves degraded-mode observability and rollback semantics only.
It does not promote any semantic verifier or reranker.
SHADOW verifier failure must preserve the deterministic baseline.
ENFORCE verifier failure remains fail-closed and is not degraded to deterministic support.
Turning the optional verifier back off must reproduce the original deterministic baseline without persisted semantic state.
Provider exception details must never be exposed in response warnings.
